assets.purpose: Show that an agent is a bounded cycle (plan, act, observe, check) with an explicit exit condition.
assets.use_when: Explaining agent architecture, why an exit condition matters, or where a tool call sits in the cycle.
assets.misuse: Not for linear pipelines (use visual:flow). Do not imply the loop runs unattended; the exit gate is the point.

parameters.steps: 3-5 items, label <= 16 chars, pinned icon; ring shows 3-4 steps, ladder shows 3-5

assets.integration: Mount the 824x820 graphic in the central zone. active_step may derive from the scene fill interval like flow highlights; data never changes with time.

assets.purpose: Show a query, its ranked retrieved chunks and the answer that cites them.
assets.use_when: Explaining RAG mechanics: ranking is a candidate list, citations close the loop.
assets.misuse: Scores are illustrative unless a measured source is declared; never present them as retrieval-quality metrics.

parameters.chunks: 2-4 items, label <= 30 chars, score 0-1 (rank derived at validation)

assets.integration: Score bars are static; no value animation. Rank order comes from derived.ranked, computed by the validator.

assets.purpose: Show one check with two named outcomes so the failure path is designed, not implied.
assets.use_when: Permission checks, schema validation, or any decision with a hold or reject branch.
assets.misuse: Not a flowchart engine: exactly one check and two outcomes. Use flow for sequences.
assets.integration: outcome (pass|fail|null) dims the other branch; the adapter may set it per scene, never from data.

assets.purpose: Show bounded retries with backoff and where exhausted work is parked.
assets.use_when: Explaining retry policy, exponential backoff, or why a dead-letter queue exists.
assets.misuse: Wait values are labels, not measurements; do not present them as observed latency. At most one successful attempt.
assets.integration: The dead-letter panel dims automatically when any attempt succeeded. Five attempts use a denser row height.

assets.purpose: Show layered memory or caching tiers and which one answered.
assets.use_when: Explaining response caches, session memory, vector lookups and model calls as ordered fallbacks.
assets.misuse: No hit rates or latencies are encoded; the HIT/MISS chips are a scene state, not statistics.
assets.integration: Tiers below the hit dim; tiers above it show MISS. Row variant wraps labels inside equal-width columns.

assets.purpose: Show an input routed to one of several models or queues by a stated rule.
assets.use_when: Explaining model routing, escalation to a larger model, or a human queue.
assets.misuse: Route labels are placeholders; never present them as a provider recommendation or a benchmark result.
assets.integration: The selected route keeps full contrast and a thicker connector; the rule text is part of the graphic.

assets.purpose: Show a typed request or response schema with required markers and one-line notes.
assets.use_when: Explaining tool schemas, function-calling arguments, or API boundaries.
assets.misuse: Not a live schema; field names are editorial. Keep to six fields so type text stays readable.

parameters.name: <= 30 chars
parameters.fields: 2-6 items, name <= 16, type <= 12, required boolean, note <= 24

assets.integration: Variant only changes the header chip and accent; highlight dims other rows.

assets.purpose: Show deployment or promotion stages with the gate that guards each one.
assets.use_when: Explaining progressive delivery, evaluation gates before promotion, or where a rollback plan sits.
assets.misuse: Not a status dashboard: the current index is editorial, not read from a deployment system.
assets.integration: Done stages show a check, the current stage a ring and NOW chip, later stages dim (column) or stay muted (rail).

assets.purpose: Show an architecture as ordered layers and which layer a change touches.
assets.use_when: Locating a change (prompt, schema, index) inside the system and explaining blast radius.
assets.misuse: Layers are labels, not a deployment diagram; do not add vendor logos or product names as facts.
assets.integration: Bands fill the slot height evenly up to 110 px each; blocks use a two-column grid.

assets.purpose: Show a short code excerpt with numbered notes explaining the lines that matter.
assets.use_when: Teaching one mechanism in code: the guard, the retry loop, the policy check.
assets.misuse: Not executed and not syntax-highlighted; keep to seven lines and four notes. Label the file as illustrative.

parameters.lines: 2-7 items (inline: <= 6), code <= 34 chars, note <= 40 chars, at most 4 notes

assets.integration: Complements the classic code layouts: use it when the numbered-note pattern fits better than active-line highlighting alone.

assets.purpose: Show how a fixed capacity (tokens, time, cost) is split and how much headroom remains.
assets.use_when: Explaining context-window planning or any bounded resource shared by parts.
assets.misuse: Values render exactly as given; parts must not exceed capacity. Never animate the numbers.
assets.integration: Headroom below ten percent switches to the warning color. Derived used/headroom come from the validator.

assets.purpose: Show a small state machine with named transitions and the current state.
assets.use_when: Explaining request lifecycles, approval workflows, or why a transition is not allowed.
assets.misuse: Not a workflow engine; at most five states and six transitions so labels stay readable. No self-transitions.
assets.integration: Adjacent forward transitions are short arrows with labels above the row; longer and backward transitions are arcs.

assets.purpose: Show a before/after technical comparison row by row with a change token.
assets.use_when: Summarizing what a change did across a few dimensions without a bar chart.
assets.misuse: Not a benchmark: values are quoted as given. Use visual:bar for measured comparisons with units.
assets.integration: Change tokens use pinned icons in colored dots plus a legend; color never carries the meaning alone.

assets.purpose: Show a nested request trace as a waterfall of spans.
assets.use_when: Explaining where a request spends time when spans nest (retrieval inside request, embed inside retrieval).
assets.misuse: Durations are labels from the source; nothing is measured here. Use visual:timeline for flat intervals.

parameters.spans: 2-6 items, label <= 18, start < end, depth 0-2, first span depth 0

assets.integration: A presentation variant of the timeline chart with nesting; axis ticks are quarter marks of the derived total.

assets.purpose: A tool that runs only behind a permission gate.
assets.use_when: Symbol for a guarded capability.
assets.misuse: Not a product logo.
assets.integration: Merge into tools/visual_library/recipes.json (16-entry ceiling) so export-svg and the catalog pick it up.

assets.purpose: A document surfaced by retrieval.
assets.use_when: Symbol for a retrieved chunk.
assets.misuse: Not a product logo.
assets.integration: Merge into tools/visual_library/recipes.json.

assets.purpose: Structured input that failed validation.
assets.use_when: Symbol for a rejected payload.
assets.misuse: Not a product logo.
assets.integration: Merge into tools/visual_library/recipes.json.

assets.purpose: A model selected by a routing rule.
assets.use_when: Symbol for model routing or fallback.
assets.misuse: Not a provider logo.
assets.integration: Merge into tools/visual_library/recipes.json.

assets.purpose: Work waiting in a queue.
assets.use_when: Symbol for queued or delayed work.
assets.misuse: Not a product logo.
assets.integration: Merge into tools/visual_library/recipes.json.

assets.purpose: Generated output that needs review.
assets.use_when: Symbol for a flagged generation.
assets.misuse: Not a product logo.
assets.integration: Merge into tools/visual_library/recipes.json.

assets.purpose: A service that passed its deployment gate.
assets.use_when: Symbol for a live deployment stage.
assets.misuse: Not a cloud-provider logo.
assets.integration: Merge into tools/visual_library/recipes.json.

assets.purpose: A run bounded by a time or token budget.
assets.use_when: Symbol for bounded compute.
assets.misuse: Not a product logo.
assets.integration: Merge into tools/visual_library/recipes.json.

assets.purpose: Horizontal bars for category labels longer than the vertical axis can show.
assets.use_when: Category labels of 12-18 characters that collide on a vertical bar chart.
assets.misuse: Same data contract as visual:bar; do not use it to fit more than six categories.
assets.integration: Proposal only, not rendered by this pack: swap xAxis/yAxis types in the shared options builder; labels move to the left axis with hideOverlap off.

assets.purpose: Step line for values that change at discrete moments (counters, config versions, limits).
assets.use_when: The value is constant between categories and jumps at a boundary; a sloped line would imply interpolation.
assets.misuse: Not for continuous measurements; keep the zero baseline and nonnegative rule.
assets.integration: Proposal only: set series.step = 'end' in the shared options builder; no data change.

assets.purpose: Two-tone heatmap that separates cells above and below a stated pass threshold.
assets.use_when: An evaluation matrix where the question is pass/fail per cell rather than gradient magnitude.
assets.misuse: The threshold must be declared in the source label; do not imply a standard cutoff.
assets.integration: Proposal only: visualMap.type = 'piecewise' with two pieces; keep the percentage labels inside cells.

assets.purpose: Donut with the total and unit in the center so the whole is visible with its parts.
assets.use_when: The total matters as much as the shares (a budget, a duration).
assets.misuse: Same four-slice limit and positive-total rule; never animate the center number.
assets.integration: Proposal only: add a static graphic text at the pie center from data totals; the expansion budget ring shows the same pattern.

assets.purpose: Timeline with parent/child indentation so overlapping intervals read as nesting.
assets.use_when: Intervals that contain each other; flat timelines make containment look like a coincidence.
assets.misuse: Not a replacement for visual:timeline when intervals are independent.
assets.integration: Implemented here as expansion:trace; folding it into the timeline chart would require a `depth` field in kit.validate_chart, which this pack does not change.
